mentions.name: Mech website
mentions.description: A website showcasing the document formatting capabilities of the Mech programming language. It is built with Mech's builtin presentation layer, Mechdown, a Markdown dialect that allows tight integration between the document and the underlying program.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Last couple weeks I've been building a new website to showcase the document formatting capabilities of my programming language Mech. It's out now:

https://mech-lang.org/post/2026-05-11-version-0.3/
